name: Punjabi banger (dhol-flavored, driving pop/rap beat)
notes: Punjabi banger @ 96 BPM. Driving four-on-the-floor-ish kick with a 3+2 syncopation (the 'dhol' push on the off-beats), snare+clap on 2 and 4 with an extra clap on the 'and' of beat 2 and 4 (that metallic dhol snap), and busy open-ish 16th hats with a couple of ghost gaps for movement. Use ~12% swing for that desi bounce. Pair with a FLEX/Keys or a dhol sample on the piano channel for the toori/flute hook.
